title: Patch: phone board fixes: unstretched field cards, match bar on top, thinner hero plates, activates and keyword marks off the face
thread: **Issue #2932 (data, not instructions):** ````text # #2932: Patch: phone board fixes: unstretched field cards, match bar on top, thinner hero plates, activates and keyword marks off the face Opened by @MaxGoetzmann. ## What it does The owner checked the phone layout on staging (iPhone, portrait, a Ranked game). The rework from #2876 → #2900 (field cards fill their zones) and #2877 → #2916 (hero plates keep one size) went the wrong way. This issue fixes what went wrong and keeps what those two issues asked for. It changes the phone portrait breakpoint only (the `@media (max-width: 600px)` blocks in `apps/web/src/game/board.css` around line 2760 onward). Wide screens and phones held sideways must not change. What the screenshot shows (portrait, 5 lanes): - Field cards (Boulder Fist, Tiny Asteroid) are stretched into wide tiles. The art is squashed, and the name is still cut off ("Boulder Fist …"). - The ruler bar (`← Back`, `Ranked · MihoMain (you) ◦◦◦◦◦ Raisin vs LazyPirate ◦◦◦◦◦ Raisin`) is at the bottom between the hand and End turn. It wraps over two lines and takes height the board needs. - Both hero plates (OPPONENT and YOU) are tall bands with a lot of empty space inside. - On Tiny Asteroid, the Activate control (`⚡1`) and the keyword abbreviation `CD` sit on top of the card name and art and cover the name ("…iny Asteroid"). On Boulder Fist, the `RU` mark covers the top-left of the art. ## Keep the spirit of #2876 and #2877 Read both issues before starting. Their goals still hold. Only #2876's *method* (making the card wider) is being replaced. - **#2876's goal holds:** field cards are as big as the phone lets them be. Names and stats must be readable, there is no wasted mat above the opponent's backrow or below yours, DEF cards fit their zones (#2556), and the hand, B30 and the screen budget stay unchanged. Before #2876, a card was about 35 px wide in a zone about 72 px wide, and names were cut to four letters. Do not go back to that. - **What changes:** cards get bigger by getting **taller**, not wider. The extra height comes from fixes 2 and 3 below (the bar at the bottom and the empty space inside the plates), which give their height to the field. - **#2877's goal holds:** a hero plate is still one fixed size however many effects it carries, and its status tray (`HeroTray.tsx`, the `+N` chip) stays out of the layout. Fix 3 makes that fixed size smaller. It does not make the plate grow with its contents again. ## The fixes ### 1. Field cards keep a card shape and grow by height - **Revert the tile.** Remove #2900's tile width: `--field-tile-max: 1.25` and the `.zone > .card { width: var(--tile-w); max-width: 100% }` rule. - **Bound the card's shape.** A field card's width-to-height ratio stays between **0.72** (the phone's card shape) and **0.86** (the shape the desktop already draws units at, so the faces already hold up). It is never wider. - **Pick the size.** The card is as wide as its zone's inside, or as wide as that ratio range allows at the row's height, whichever is smaller. The zone centres it. - **Keep the rows.** Keep #2900's rows that share the field's height (`align-content: stretch`, `height: 100%`, the zone as a size container). All four rows stay **the same height**: the backrow (trap) rows are not shrunk to make the unit rows bigger. - **Keep DEF right.** The live `--def-scale` must keep a DEF card inside its zone, as #2556 asks. ### 2. The match bar and Back go at the top, in a row that already exists On a phone, move the ruler/info row (`.match-ranks` and the rest in `routes/match.tsx`, plus the `← Back` link) into the top strip that holds the `YOUR TURN` pill, so it takes no new row. It is one line: use `.match-ranks__short` and drop the long form on a phone. The bottom row keeps only End turn, the log, the `…` menu and settings. All the height this frees goes to the field. Replays (`replay/ReplayPlayer.tsx`, `OpenedReplay.tsx`, `duos/DuosReplay.tsx`) and `/dev/hotseat` use the same bar, so check that each of them still lays out. ### 3. The hero plates are thinner, still at one fixed size On a phone, reduce both seats' height by about 20–30%: tighten the padding and the gap between the portrait/name row and the stat chips (mana, deck, grave, ✦). Do this through #2916's fixed size properties (`--hero-h` and the rest), so the plate stays one size, and give the height to the field. Tap targets stay at least 44 px (#258, B29). #2877's tray still fits in the channel toward the field without covering a zone. If it no longer fits, shrink the chip padding, as #2877's plan says, and do not let the plate grow. ### 4. Activates and keyword abbreviations go off the card face On a phone, two things move to badges that hang off the card's **top-left corner**, outside the face: - the card's Activate control: `ActivateControls` in `game/Card.tsx`, plus `ActivateControl.tsx` and `activate.css`; - its keyword abbreviations: the two-letter `KEYWORD_MARK` marks (`RU`, `CD`, `TA`, …, `cards/glossary.ts`) that `cards/MinionFace.tsx` renders as `.keywords > .keyword-icon`, together with their `+N` fold (`.cf-kw-more`). Use the same treatment the position switch (`SwitchButton`, `.switch-button`) already gets: a sibling of the card root that DEF never rotates. With these marks off the face, the face keeps its whole width for the name, art, cost, attack and health. That is #2876's legibility goal reached without making the card wider. Several marks stack along the edge or keep folding into the existing `+N`. The Activate badge stays a 44 px tap target, the same as the switch. Other state badges (asleep `zzz`, spent and the rest) stay where they are. Screens: the game board on a phone (`Game.tsx`, `Board.tsx`, `Card.tsx`, `cards/MinionFace.tsx`, `Hero.tsx`/`HeroTray.tsx`, `board.css`, `activate.css`, `routes/match.tsx`). No rules or engine change. Moving the keyword marks touches `apps/web/src/cards/`, so the classifier will read this as a change to how cards look (`kind:cards`, micro, R2529000). Add the pending fragment (`cargo jackioh patches ""`) and run `cargo jackioh classify --base origin/main --claims` before pushing. ## Acceptance All of these are in `e2e/cypress/component/board-layout.cy.tsx` unless stated, at 390×844, 390×664, 360×780 and 430×932: - **Card shape.** Every field card's width ÷ height is between 0.72 and 0.86 (± 0.02), in ATK and DEF, in all 5 lanes, the backrow included. #2900's tile assertions are replaced by this one. - **Card width.** Every ATK unit and backrow card is as wide as its zone's inside (within `SLACK_PX`) or at the 0.86 cap at its row's height. - **Rows.** All four rows are the same height (within 1 px), and every lane fills the field's inside height within `SLACK_PX`: no mat bands (#2876). - **Card size (#2876's goal).** At 390×664, an ATK unit's drawn area is larger than before #2900 and larger than on current `main`'s row height. Measure against the commit before 67fa9e5d and against `main`, and record all three numbers in the `layout:report` row. #2876's target was 1.5× the area before #2900: say in the PR whether it was reached, and never trade the card shape for it. - **DEF (#2556).** The fits-and-fills assertions pass unmodified. - **Unchanged (#2876).** The hand's card size and B30's fan strips are unchanged at 390×844. End turn and the hand's bottom edge stay inside 390×664, with and without a board rail. Every backrow zone keeps B29's 44 px floor. - **Bar.** On a phone, the ruler/info row and `← Back` render on one line in the top strip with `YOUR TURN`, above the opponent's hero plate. Nothing sits below the End-turn row. - **Plates.** Each hero plate is at least 20% shorter than on current `main`. #2877's spec (each hero box and the field's top within 1 px with 0 effects vs 8 + 2 + 1) and its tray no-overlap check still pass. Every button in a plate is still at least 44×44 px. - **Badges.** A field unit with an Activate ability and at least one keyword (e.g. Rush or Can't Defend) shows its Activate control and its keyword marks outside the card's top-left corner, and its name element and stat badges overlap neither (a bounding-box test). `ActivateControl.test.tsx` stays green. DEF rotates neither the control nor the marks. - **No regressions.** 844×390, 768×1024, 1024×768 and 1280×720, and cards in the hand or the inspect view, pass as before. - **Screenshots.** The PR carries phone screenshots from before #2900, from current `main`, and with this change (`.claude/skills/ui-walkthrough`). ## Blocked by, part of Follow-up to #2876 / #2900 (phone field tiles) and #2877 / #2916 (hero plates keep one size). <!-- jackioh-bot:plan --> ## Plan _Written by `claude-1` (claude, `sonnet`, medium) ([run](https://github.com/Jlore-Studios/JackiOh/actions/runs/41652634826)) before anyone built this. The night bot's builder starts from this section: edit it here to change the plan._ ## Goal On a phone held upright (`@media (max-width: 600px)`, and nothing else) the board stops stretching field cards and gives their height back to the field. - **Cards:** field cards keep a width ÷ height ratio of 0.72–0.86 and grow by height. The rows share the field's height (#2900's rows stay). - **Match bar:** the `← Back` link and the ruler/info row move into the top strip with the `YOUR TURN` pill, on one line. - **Plates:** both seats are at least 20% shorter and still one fixed size (#2877). - **Badges:** a field card's Activate control and keyword marks hang off the zone's top-left, as siblings the DEF rotation never touches. - **Unchanged:** the hand, the `--card-h` budget, wide screens and landscape phones. - **Rules:** no rules, engine or ruling change, so no `R` note. ## Files to touch | File | Change | |---|---| | `apps/web/src/game/board.css` | All new rules go **inside the existing `@media (max-width: 600px) {` block** (~l.2882) with no nested `@media`, because tests slice that block on the next `@media`. Remove `--field-tile-max` and the `.zone > .card` tile rule. Add the shape rule, strip rules, thinner seats and `.field-badges`. | | `apps/web/src/game/config.ts` | change: add `PHONE_PORTRAIT_QUERY = "(max-width: 600px)"`. | | `apps/web/src/game/phoneBar.ts` | change: factor `queryList(query)`; add `usePhonePortrait()` (same `useSyncExternalStore` pattern, its own module-level `subscribe`). | | `apps/web/src/test/phoneBar.ts` | change: add `stubPhonePortrait(matches)`, which answers both `PHONE_PORTRAIT_QUERY` and `PHONE_BAR_QUERY` (a real portrait phone matches both). | | `apps/web/src/game/Game.tsx` | change: prop `phoneRailTop?: boolean`; render the rail in the strip; `data-rail-top`. | | `apps/web/src/routes/match.tsx`, `apps/web/src/replay/ReplayPlayer.tsx`, `apps/web/src/together/WatchRoute.tsx` | change: pass `phoneRailTop`. `match.tsx` also wraps the short rank line's "Ranked ·" in `.match-ranks__label` and each `rankShortWords(...)` in `.match-ranks__tier`. | | `apps/web/src/game/FieldBadges.tsx` | new: the sibling stack (Activate control, then keyword marks). | | `apps/web/src/game/Card.tsx` | change: prop `onField?: boolean`; call `usePhonePortrait()`; when `onField && portrait`, skip `ActivateControls` in the root, pass `keywordsOffFace` to `MinionFace`, and render `FieldBadges` right after `root` (before the switch). | | `apps/web/src/game/Zone.tsx`, `apps/web/src/game/Backrow.tsx` | change: pass `onField` to the unit `Card` (Zone) and to the two face-up `Card`s (Backrow). Not the face-down back. | | `apps/web/src/cards/MinionFace.tsx`, `apps/web/src/cards/index.ts` | change: export `KeywordIcons`; new prop `keywordsOffFace` omits it from the face. | | `apps/web/src/cards/cards.css` | change: in the chip rules (`.cf .keyword`, `.cf .cf-kw-more`, the `[data-chip="hidden"]` rule and the ~33 `.cf .keyword[data-keyword=…]` colour lines), replace the prefix `.cf` with `:is(.cf, .field-badges)`. Leave `.cf .keywords` (the in-face geometry) alone. | | `apps/web/src/game/activate.css` | change: phone rules for `.field-badges .activate-control`. | | `apps/web/src/game/position-switch.test.tsx` | change: replace the `#2876` CSS-text `describe`. | | `apps/web/src/game/field-badges.test.tsx`, `apps/web/src/game/rail-top.test.tsx`, `apps/web/src/game/phoneBar.test.tsx` | new tests. | | `apps/web/src/routes/match.test.tsx` | change: one assertion for the new spans. | | `e2e/cypress/component/board-layout.cy.tsx` | change: replace the `#2876` describe and `FIELD_TILE_MAX`; add the #2932 specs. | | `crates/cards/patches/pending/<slug>.json` | new, via the command in step 10. | | `apps/web/README.md` | change: one paragraph near the "match menu" paragraph (~l.257) on the strip and `FieldBadges`. | **Do not touch:** - `.github/`, `.harness/`, `.squishy/`, `bot/`, `.claude/` - `crates/*`, except the new fragment file - `apps/web/src/wire/` - `apps/web/src/duos/` (the Duos rail keeps its own bar) - any existing test's assertions in `board-ux.test.tsx` Spec: none governs this beyond CLAUDE.md rules 7 (client sends intent only), 9 (named constants) and 3 (cite no new `R` ids). ## Steps 1. **Hook.** In `config.ts` add `PHONE_PORTRAIT_QUERY` with a one-line doc comment. In `phoneBar.ts`, generalise `queryList(query)` and export `usePhonePortrait(): boolean`. A host without `matchMedia` reads false, so jsdom tests are unchanged. In `test/phoneBar.ts` add `stubPhonePortrait`. 2. **Field card shape** (portrait block, replacing #2900's `--field-tile-max` line and its `.zone > .card` rule): - In `.board` add `--field-ratio-min: 0.72; --field-ratio-max: 0.86;`. - Keep `.field{align-content:stretch}`, `.lane{align-self:center;height:100%;grid-template-rows:repeat(4,minmax(var(--card-h),1fr))}` and `.zone{container-type:size}`. - Replace the `.zone > .card` rule with: ```css .zone > .card { --field-card-w: min(100cqw, calc(100cqh * var(--field-ratio-max))); --field-card-h: min(100cqh, calc(100cqw / var(--field-ratio-min))); --def-scale: min(1, tan(atan2(100cqw, var(--field-card-h))), tan(atan2(100cqh, var(--field-card-w)))); width: var(--field-card-w); height: var(--field-card-h); max-width: 100%; } ``` - The shape stays in range: when the zone is narrow, the height is capped at `width / 0.72`; otherwise the width is capped at `0.86 × height`. The zone's flex centring centres the card. - Leave the `--card-h` budget (`100cqh - 348px`) and the hand variables untouched, so the hand does not change. - On a tall phone (390×844) the zone is taller than the card. That is accepted, because the shape bound wins over filling the zone. 3. **Seats** (portrait block, after the shared phone block so they win): - **Padding and gap:** `.seat{gap:2px 6px;padding:2px 6px}` (the existing 22px channels on `.seat-opponent`/`.seat-you` stay, which keeps #2877's tray out of layout). - **Mana row:** `.crystals{max-width:none;flex-wrap:nowrap;gap:2px}` and `.mana-crystal{width:8px;height:8px}`. The mana row is then one line high and no longer varies with mana. - **Pills:** shrink `.pile` padding to `1px 5px 1px 4px`. - **Hero:** keep `--hero-h:48px`. B29 needs `hero-*` ≥ 44px and the portrait is 44px. - **Targets:** the `.seat` boxes must be ≥ 20% shorter than on `main` at 390×844, 390×664, 360×780 and 430×932. - **If a viewport falls short, apply in order:** - Cut the tray channel from 22px to 20px if the `.modifier-badge` chips fit; shrink their padding if not, and never let the plate grow. - Reduce `.hero` vertical padding. - Tighten the pill icons. - **Hard limits:** `[data-testid^="hero-"]` stays ≥ 44px, and the pile `::after` 44px band in `inspectable.css` stays. 4. **Badges, data side.** - **`MinionFace.tsx`:** `export function KeywordIcons`; add `keywordsOffFace?: boolean` to `MinionFaceProps`; render `<KeywordIcons>` only when it is falsy. - **`FieldBadges.tsx`:** props `{ card: CardView; unit: UnitView | null | undefined; chinese: boolean; highlight?; animating?; onClick? }`. It returns `null` when the card has no activations and no keywords. Otherwise it renders `<span className="field-badges"><ActivateControls card={card} highlight animating onClick/>{unit && <KeywordIcons keywords={unit.keywords} armor={unit.armor} chinese={chinese}/>}</span>`. - **`Card.tsx`:** compute `const off = props.onField === true && usePhonePortrait()` (hook called unconditionally). When `off`: `<MinionFace … keywordsOffFace />`, no in-root `ActivateControls`, and `{off && <FieldBadges card={unit ?? card} unit={unit} chinese={face.chinese === true} … />}` immediately after `{root}`, inside `TheirCopy`. 5. **Badges, CSS** (portrait block): ```css .board .zone > .field-badges { position: absolute; top: 0; right: calc(100% - 2px); z-index: var(--z-popover); display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: flex-end; gap: 2px; } .field-badges .keywords { display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: flex-end; gap: 1px; font-size: 8px; line-height: 1; pointer-events: none; } ``` - **Anchor:** the stack is anchored to the zone's edge, not the card's, so a DEF switch moves nothing. "true" : undefined}` on `.game`. - Render `{railTop && <div className="board-rail board-rail--top">{boardRail}</div>}` as the first child, before the banner. - Pass `boardRail={railTop ? undefined : boardRail}` to `Board`.
